title: The Leeward Current
author: Emrys Sandoval
blurb: Beatrix Whitlock, a desert ranger tracking a thief across nothing, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then an old rival hires the crew for the one job that was sworn off long ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found before the glacier calving season opens the route — briefly.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
